bloodmoon_elder: I'm Gravemoss, elder of Bloodmoon Village. You're inside it now, through the gate off the island road. This is the only safe ground left on Fenris, and even that's generous. Talk to the people round the square before you go out. Every one of them has a reason you'll need.
fenris_village_elder: I'm Corwell, and I was the Baron's huntsman. Now I live in Bloodmoon with everyone else who's left. Ashbury ruled this isle alive and he rules it worse dead. His manor is north, at the end of the island road, and somebody needs to finish what the curse started.
fenris_keep_scout: I'm Scout Merrin. I watched Baron Ashbury's manor from behind a hedge for months, and now I come back here to sleep. It's north up the island road, behind the gate. Its guards haven't been relieved since the curse, and neither has the Baron.
fenris_altar_warden: I'm Orlan, the warden. For ten years I kept watch at the arch in the west ridge, where the stair goes down to Shadowpine Altar and the place the curse was cast. Nothing climbed back up that I saw. I watch from here now, and I send people north-west who can do more than watch.
fenris_grave_hunter: I'm Selke, the gravehunter. Cur's Grave is east of the village, the whole east shore, and it's a kennel for ghosts. I can handle the dogs. It's the keeper I don't like the sound of, and I've only ever heard him.
